'''Lalkan''' was a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served [[Vortga]] the Hutt. However, as Vortga grew paranoid in his old age, he attempted to execute all of his servants that knew about his [[Vortga's hidden complex|hidden complex]]. Lalkan was among those targeted, but he managed to escape. He eventually shared his knowledge with [[Jacek]].<ref name="LoNH" />
